heroHeadline: Ten Western Governments Back Tunis Deal as Libya's Own Institutions Question It
heroSubtitle: Italy, France, Germany and seven other Western governments issued a joint declaration on August 26 endorsing the Tunis '4+4' electoral agreement, even as the Presidential Council and High State Council keep disputing the text's legitimacy at home. A day later, Qatar's foreign minister met Khalifa Haftar in Benghazi — the first senior Qatari visit east since Libya's 2014 split — while the unclaimed assassination of LNA intelligence chief Fawzi al-Mansouri and repeated drone strikes on the Zawiya refinery still overshadow the fragile GNU-GNS thaw.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
